coefficient_replay.scope: Original retained-four TRAIN coefficients only; excludes omitted modes and online coefficients.

component_gradient_replay.scope: Initial saved component vectors only; no fresh autodiff or intermediate component-vector reconstruction.

selection_semantics: last accepted state, minimum among initial and accepted COMBINED objective states
original_selection_string: minimum accepted/initial combined full-training objective; no development/validation selection

qualification_scope.required_scope: prescribed original fixed finite DFG channel and boundary conditions

limitations: No neural evaluation, training, native solve or validation access.
Intermediate vectors are absent: scalar hash/Armijo chains checked, not independent intermediate vector or two-loop replay.
Saved full teacher objective/gradient replay receipt checked, not independently recomputed.
Pending/incomplete evaluation events are retained and checked; interrupted partial sums are not full measured objectives.
A terminal unaccepted or interrupted first trial may reset curvature without a retained reset scalar; final empty history is allowed but its cause remains unresolved.
Periodic/final curvature arrays checked internally; correspondence to missing intermediate vectors cannot be independently reconstructed.
